policy: Paper bets only: £10 WIN or £5 each-way (£10 total) singles; £1 each-way per Lucky 15 line (£30). For entries with a definite saved early quote, apply simulated Best Odds Guaranteed: if reported starting price is longer, use SP; otherwise retain the researched price. Include the original stake in winning returns. Legacy entries with ambiguous early price keep their recorded settlement basis. No actual bookmaker wagers.

pricingPolicy.rule: Settlement uses the higher of the unmodified early selection price and later reported SP whenever both are unambiguous. Without later SP, use original early price. SP cannot worsen recorded early terms.
pricingPolicy.legacyOddsHandling: Pre-9-Oct bets with ambiguous early odds remain on their previous settlement-price basis.
pricingPolicy.quoteSources: Published pre-race price retained; later SP stored in result.sp or settlementOdds with its provenance.
pricingPolicy.caveat: Retrospective bookmaker odds are not proof of actual bet acceptance, BOG eligibility, or matched each-way terms; users must check prices at placement.
pricingPolicy.notes: Published original early price never rewritten; later independently found race-day bookmaker offers can improve hypothetical settlement when sourced; do not imply they were accepted real bets.
pricingPolicy.sourceOfTruth: bestAvailableOdds and original immutable selectionOdds; use max documented bookmaker pre-off and official SP
